description: This file defines an EmployeeSalaryController class within the OrangeHRM system, responsible for handling employee salary view logic. It retrieves pay grade, currency, and pay period data and prepares a Vue component with props for rendering employee salary details.

classes.name: EmployeeSalaryController
classes.description: Controller class that manages the display and data preparation for employee salary details, extending base employee view functionalities.

methods.name: getPayGradeService
methods.description: Retrieves the PayGradeService instance from the service container.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares data and Vue component props for rendering the employee's salary information, including handling missing employee number.

methods.name: getDataGroupsForCapabilityCheck
methods.description: Returns an array specifying data groups required for capability permissions checks.
